sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by John Hendrik. “Mondnacht in Sanssouci.” Gloria G.O. 10155, matrix Bi 80, recorded 29 April 1931. Title list at musiktiteldb.de, compiled by Henry König from discographic and trade sources.
sources.title: Mondnacht in Sanssouci — Gloria G.O. 10155
sources.creator: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester; John Hendrik, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: The title-list entry gives 29 April 1931 as the recording date and leaves the release-date column empty. The structured date therefore identifies the session, not the commercial issue of Gloria G.O. 10155. No publicly accessible transfer of this disc was located during the recording-link audit.

sources.shortCitation: D 4431, “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen” (master recorded 1932)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden’s danseorkester, refrain sung by Carljohann Volbach. “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen.” From the sound film Melodie der Liebe; catalogue number D 4431, matrix Bi 644, n.d. Digital transfer published by the Internet Archive from the 78 rpm collection of Leif Druedahl.
sources.title: Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen — D 4431
sources.creator: Eric Harden’s danseorkester; Carljohann Volbach, refrain vocal
sources.repository: Internet Archive, 78 rpm collection of Leif Druedahl
sources.researchNote: The Internet Archive metadata supplies catalogue number D 4431 and matrix Bi 644 but no label or date; only an audio transfer is supplied, not a photograph of the physical label. The title-list entry for Gloria G.O. 10303 identifies the same title, performers and matrix, dates the master to Berlin, studio 4, on 11 June 1932 and gives November 1932 as the German issue date. The structured date identifies the shared recording session. Neither November 1932 nor the year of the film is assigned as the issue date of D 4431; that pressing’s label and issue date remain unestablished. The Danish performer wording is transcribed from the Internet Archive metadata.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10303, “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen” (1932)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by Carljohann Volbach. “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen!” From Melodie der Liebe; music by Walter Jurmann and Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter. Gloria G.O. 10303, matrix Bi 644. Recorded in Berlin, studio 4, 11 June 1932; issued November 1932. Title-list entry at Musiktiteldb.de, citing Discographie der deutschen Tanzmusik, vol. 8.
sources.title: Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen — Gloria G.O. 10303
sources.creator: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester; Carljohann Volbach, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: The title-list entry distinguishes the recording session (Berlin, studio 4, 11 June 1932) from the Gloria issue (November 1932). This source documents Gloria G.O. 10303 specifically. The Internet Archive transfer numbered D 4431 reports the same matrix, Bi 644, but does not identify its issuing label or date; the Gloria imprint and November issue date are not assigned to that pressing. No second listening reference is created.

works.title: Wie gern’ möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen
works.sortTitle: Wie gern’ möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen

contributions.scopeNote: Recorded the song for Gloria in Berlin on 29 April 1931.

The Internet Archive identifies Eric Harden’s danseorkester on transfer D 4431, matrix Bi 644. Independently, the Musiktiteldb.de entry documents Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester with Carljohann Volbach on Gloria G.O. 10303, the same matrix, recorded in Berlin on 11 June 1932. The Danish wording follows the transfer metadata; the label of D 4431 has not been examined.
